To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the transfer of strategic organizational practice to subsidiaries of multinational companies is affected by the social embeddedness of the transfer, the organizational embeddedness of the practice and the relational embeddedness of the relationship between the transfer agent and the recipient unit.

the transfer of strategic organizational practice from one subsidiary to another is a complex process that is embedded in the social, organizational, institutional, and relational context of the recipient organization.
the transfer of a practice from a headquarters unit to a recipient unit in another country is successful if the practice is institutionalized in the recipient unit.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transfer and institutionalization of strategic organizational practices in multinational corporations.
the phenomenon of the transfer of strategic organizational practice within multinational companies.
the transfer of strategic organizational practice within multinational companies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the transfer process is a social process, and the success of the transfer depends on a variety of social factors.
the transnational transfer process is a complex phenomenon.
the transfer of organizational practices is an extremely complex process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to identify a number of important contextual factors which are relevant for the success of a transnational transfer of practices.
the transnational transfer process is not a linear process.
we have developed a model of transfer success that is based on a contextual perspective and that is applicable to the transfer of any strategic practice.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the success of a practice transfer depends not only on the characteristics of the transferred practice, but also on the characteristics of recipient and source units, as well as their embeddedness in their national and organizational contexts.
a transnational transfer of practices is a process of institutionalization.
the transfer of strategic organizational practice is a multilevel phenomenon.
